title: Example Project: Conversational Assistant
summary: A sample project exploring an AI assistant that helps people ask questions, find information, and learn through conversation.
body: This is an example project for previewing the website, rather than a report of work completed by UGAIL.
The sample concept is a conversational assistant for everyday learning. A project description could explain its motivation, who it serves, and how the system works.
Use this space to describe your approach, progress, and next steps. Replace this example with a real project and add screenshots or resource links when they are available.
